goal: The legacy editor is retired stage by stage: retained originals render without it, profiles are the ordinary launch, a new profile starts on Paper, and the legacy write paths go.
scope: R1: retained originals and read-only copies render without the editor
R3: a new profile starts with its managed runtime on, so New page is a Paper
R2: profiles mode is the ordinary launch; an old library is adopted into a profile
R4: the legacy write paths and the Tiptap editor leave the app
acceptance: A retained original shows its text with no editing surface, links open, history reads
A new profile on an installation that knows a runtime, or an application that carries one, runs its runtime with no setup
An ordinary launch opens profiles; a legacy library found at launch is adopted, never lost
After R4 no code path writes the legacy store; rollback, retained originals and adoption still work; the Tiptap packages are gone
nextAction: R4: remove the legacy write paths (docs:create, docs:save, docs:delete, docs:restore, docs:proposal, the local branches of the agent tools and of agent-edits.js) and the Tiptap packages; keep the readers, retained originals, rollback and adoption; move the development tours that still write the legacy library onto profiles or retire them. Stop when no code path writes the legacy store and the app builds without @tiptap.
truthReview: 2026-09-30: R1, R2 and R3 are in and rehearsed on macOS: a retained original renders without an editor (switch rehearsal), a new profile starts on the remembered runtime (portable rehearsal), and an ordinary launch opens profiles, offers adoption of a legacy library, honours not now, and --legacy still opens the legacy library (launch rehearsal). 61 development tours now pass --legacy; the unit suite and the legacy journey pass. Nothing removed yet.
screenshotReview: Visual runs approved the same day: all entries pixel-identical, including the retained-view stills now rendered without the editor. Screenshots of the adoption offer and the adopted profile are in the launch rehearsal folder.
